startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Where the crawl begins — the site root, a course-index page, or individual course pages.

urlPattern.title: Course-page URL pattern
urlPattern.description: Regular expression a URL must match to be crawled beyond the start URLs. Leave empty to follow every same-site link (spends the page budget faster).

maxPages.title: Page budget
maxPages.description: Maximum pages fetched. Start small (10-20) to check extraction quality before a full run.

requestsPerMinute.title: Requests per minute
requestsPerMinute.description: Politeness throttle. 30/min is one request every two seconds.

useSitemap.title: Seed from sitemap.xml
useSitemap.description: Read the site's sitemap first and seed matching URLs — usually finds course pages far more efficiently than link-following.

translate.title: Translate to Arabic with Claude
translate.description: Fill title_ar / summary_ar / audience_ar / highlights_ar using the Claude API. Requires the API key below; costs tokens per row.

anthropicApiKey.title: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.description: Only needed when translation is on. Stored as a secret.
